title: Use Seedance reference tags (e.g., @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard) to…
content:
Use Seedance reference tags (e.g., @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard) to lock exact character identities and the environment in the prompt.

Specify duration and aspect ratio explicitly (e.g., 30 seconds | 16:9) at the start of the Seedance 2.5 prompt.

Instruct Seedance to maintain perfect identity and wardrobe continuity throughout the entire sequence to prevent face/costume drift.

Break a long video into timestamped beats (e.g., 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:06, etc.) with shot type + action to control pacing and choreography.

Define camera language explicitly (tracking shots, controlled handheld, low-angle movement, 180° orbits, push-ins) and forbid impossible camera teleportation to keep motion coherent.

Constrain VFX by tying effects to specific limbs/movements and stating that magic enhances (not replaces) choreography to preserve readable martial arts.

Add negative constraints (no dialogue, no subtitles, no text/logos/watermark, no weapons, no blood/gore, no extra characters) to avoid unwanted elements.

Specify environment interaction details (rain, wet-stone reflections, petals reacting to energy, lantern flicker, fog/fabric responding) to increase realism and consistency.

Lock character-to-power mapping explicitly (Aisha = orange-gold fire; Harumin = blue-silver wind/frost) and instruct “do not swap their powers” to prevent attribute drift.

Define audio requirements (intense percussion, footsteps on wet stone, cloth/breathing/whooshes, fire/wind/ice impacts) and “no dialogue” to guide sound generation.

es.content:
Usa etiquetas de referencia de Seedance (por ejemplo, @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard) para fijar identidades exactas de los personajes y el entorno en el prompt.

Especifica explícitamente la duración y la relación de aspecto (por ejemplo, 30 seconds | 16:9) al inicio del prompt de Seedance 2.5.

Indica a Seedance que mantenga una continuidad perfecta de identidad y vestuario durante toda la secuencia para evitar desviaciones en el rostro o el atuendo.

Divide un video largo en beats con marcas de tiempo (por ejemplo, 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:06, etc.) con tipo de plano + acción para controlar el ritmo y la coreografía.

Define explícitamente el lenguaje de cámara (tracking shots, handheld controlado, movimiento en contrapicado, órbitas de 180°, push-ins) y prohíbe la teletransportación imposible de la cámara para mantener la coherencia del movimiento.

Restringe los VFX vinculando los efectos a extremidades/movimientos específicos y estableciendo que la magia potencia (no reemplaza) la coreografía para preservar la legibilidad de las artes marciales.

Añade restricciones negativas (sin diálogo, sin subtítulos, sin texto/logos/watermark, sin armas, sin sangre/gore, sin personajes extra) para evitar elementos no deseados.

Especifica detalles de interacción con el entorno (lluvia, reflejos en piedra mojada, pétalos reaccionando a la energía, parpadeo de faroles, niebla/tela respondiendo) para aumentar el realismo y la consistencia.

Fija explícitamente la correspondencia personaje-poder (Aisha = fuego naranja-dorado; Harumin = viento/escarcha azul plateado) e indica “do not swap their powers” para evitar desviaciones de atributos.

Define los requisitos de audio (percusión intensa, pasos sobre piedra mojada, tela/respiración/swooshes, impactos de fuego/viento/hielo) y “no dialogue” para guiar la generación de sonido.

fr.content:
Utilisez les balises de référence Seedance (par ex. @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard) pour verrouiller l’identité exacte des personnages et l’environnement dans le prompt.

Spécifiez explicitement la durée et le ratio d’aspect (par ex. 30 seconds | 16:9) au début du prompt Seedance 2.5.

Indiquez à Seedance de maintenir une continuité parfaite de l’identité et des costumes tout au long de la séquence afin d’éviter toute dérive du visage ou de la tenue.

Découpez une longue vidéo en beats horodatés (par ex. 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:06, etc.) avec type de plan + action pour contrôler le rythme et la chorégraphie.

Définissez explicitement le langage caméra (tracking shots, handheld contrôlé, mouvement en contre-plongée, orbits à 180°, push-ins) et interdisez toute téléportation impossible de la caméra afin de conserver une motion cohérente.

Encadrez les VFX en reliant les effets à des membres/mouvements spécifiques et en précisant que la magie amplifie la chorégraphie (et ne la remplace pas) afin de préserver la lisibilité des arts martiaux.

Ajoutez des contraintes négatives (no dialogue, no subtitles, no text/logos/watermark, no weapons, no blood/gore, no extra characters) pour éviter les éléments indésirables.

Précisez les détails d’interaction avec l’environnement (rain, wet-stone reflections, petals reacting to energy, lantern flicker, fog/fabric responding) afin d’augmenter le réalisme et la cohérence.

Verrouillez explicitement l’association personnage-pouvoir (Aisha = orange-gold fire; Harumin = blue-silver wind/frost) et indiquez “do not swap their powers” pour éviter toute dérive des attributs.

Définissez les exigences audio (intense percussion, footsteps on wet stone, cloth/breathing/whooshes, fire/wind/ice impacts) ainsi que “no dialogue” pour guider la génération sonore.

ja.content:
Seedance の参照タグ（例: @.Aisha、@.Harumin、@.FrozenCourtyard）を使って、prompt 内でキャラクターの正確なアイデンティティと環境を固定します。

Seedance 2.5 の prompt の冒頭で、duration と aspect ratio を明示的に指定します（例: 30 seconds | 16:9）。

シーケンス全体を通して、顔や衣装の drift を防ぐために、完全なアイデンティティと wardrobe の一貫性を維持するよう Seedance に指示します。

長い動画は timestamp 付きの beats（例: 0:00–0:03、0:03–0:06 など）に分け、shot type + action を併記して、pacing と choreography を制御します。

camera language を明確に定義します（tracking shots、controlled handheld、low-angle movement、180° orbits、push-ins など）。また、motion の整合性を保つため、あり得ない camera teleportation は禁止します。

VFX は、効果を特定の手足や動きに結び付け、magic は choreography を置き換えるのではなく強化するものだと明記して、読み取りやすい martial arts を維持します。

不要な要素を避けるために、negative constraints を追加します（no dialogue、no subtitles、no text/logos/watermark、no weapons、no blood/gore、no extra characters）。

リアリズムと一貫性を高めるために、環境との相互作用の詳細を指定します（rain、wet-stone reflections、energy に反応する petals、lantern の flicker、fog/fabric の反応など）。

キャラクターと power の対応を明確に固定します（Aisha = orange-gold fire; Harumin = blue-silver wind/frost）。属性の drift を防ぐために、“do not swap their powers” と指示します。

音声要件を定義します（intense percussion、wet stone の上の footsteps、cloth/breathing/whooshes、fire/wind/ice impacts など）。“no dialogue” も明記して、sound generation を誘導します。

ko.content:
Seedance 참조 태그(예: @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard)를 사용해 프롬프트에서 정확한 캐릭터 정체성과 환경을 고정하세요.

Seedance 2.5 프롬프트의 시작 부분에 지속 시간과 화면 비율을 명시적으로 지정하세요(예: 30 seconds | 16:9).

전체 시퀀스 동안 완벽한 정체성과 의상 연속성을 유지하도록 Seedance에 지시해 얼굴/의상 드리프트를 방지하세요.

긴 영상을 타임스탬프가 포함된 비트(예: 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:06 등)로 나누고, 페이싱과 안무를 제어하기 위해 shot type + action을 함께 적으세요.

카메라 언어를 명시적으로 정의하세요(tracking shots, controlled handheld, low-angle movement, 180° orbits, push-ins) 그리고 불가능한 camera teleportation은 금지해 동작의 일관성을 유지하세요.

VFX는 특정 팔다리/동작에 연결해 제한하고, 마법이 안무를 대체하는 것이 아니라 보강하도록 명시해 읽기 쉬운 무술 동작을 보존하세요.

부정 조건을 추가하세요(no dialogue, no subtitles, no text/logos/watermark, no weapons, no blood/gore, no extra characters) 원치 않는 요소를 피하기 위해서입니다.

환경 상호작용의 세부 사항을 지정하세요(rain, wet-stone reflections, petals reacting to energy, lantern flicker, fog/fabric responding) 현실감과 일관성을 높이기 위해서입니다.

캐릭터와 능력의 매핑을 명확히 고정하세요(Aisha = orange-gold fire; Harumin = blue-silver wind/frost) 그리고 속성 드리프트를 방지하기 위해 “do not swap their powers”라고 지시하세요.

오디오 요구사항을 정의하세요(intense percussion, footsteps on wet stone, cloth/breathing/whooshes, fire/wind/ice impacts) 그리고 사운드 생성을 안내하기 위해 “no dialogue”를 포함하세요.

pt.content:
Use tags de referência do Seedance (por exemplo, @.Aisha, @.Harumin, @.FrozenCourtyard) para travar identidades exatas dos personagens e o ambiente no prompt.

Especifique duração e proporção de tela explicitamente (por exemplo, 30 seconds | 16:9) no início do prompt do Seedance 2.5.

Instrua o Seedance a manter continuidade perfeita de identidade e figurino ao longo de toda a sequência para evitar drift de rosto/figurino.

Divida um vídeo longo em beats com timestamp (por exemplo, 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:06, etc.), com tipo de plano + ação para controlar o ritmo e a coreografia.

Defina a linguagem de câmera explicitamente (tracking shots, handheld controlado, movimento em low-angle, órbitas de 180°, push-ins) e proíba teletransporte impossível da câmera para manter o movimento coerente.

Restrinja os VFX vinculando os efeitos a membros/movimentos específicos e afirmando que a magia potencializa (não substitui) a coreografia, para preservar a legibilidade das artes marciais.

Adicione restrições negativas (sem diálogo, sem legendas, sem texto/logos/watermark, sem armas, sem sangue/gore, sem personagens extras) para evitar elementos indesejados.

Especifique detalhes de interação com o ambiente (chuva, reflexos na pedra molhada, pétalas reagindo à energia, tremulação de lanternas, neblina/tecido respondendo) para aumentar o realismo e a consistência.

Trave explicitamente o mapeamento personagem-para-poder (Aisha = fogo laranja-dourado; Harumin = vento/geada azul-prateado) e instrua “do not swap their powers” para evitar drift de atributos.

Defina os requisitos de áudio (percussão intensa, passos sobre pedra molhada, tecido/respiração/whooshes, impactos de fogo/vento/gelo) e “no dialogue” para orientar a geração de som.

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 参考标签（例如 @.Aisha、@.Harumin、@.FrozenCourtyard）来在 prompt 中锁定准确的角色身份和环境。

在 Seedance 2.5 prompt 的开头明确指定时长和画幅比例（例如 30 seconds | 16:9）。

指示 Seedance 在整个序列中保持完美的角色身份和服装连续性，以防止脸部/服装漂移。

将长视频拆分为带时间戳的节拍（例如 0:00–0:03、0:03–0:06 等），并标注 shot type + action，以控制节奏和编排。

明确定义镜头语言（tracking shots、controlled handheld、low-angle movement、180° orbits、push-ins），并禁止不可能的 camera teleportation，以保持运动连贯。

通过将 VFX 与特定肢体/动作绑定，并说明魔法是增强（而不是取代）编舞，来约束特效，以保留清晰可读的武术动作。

添加负向约束（no dialogue, no subtitles, no text/logos/watermark, no weapons, no blood/gore, no extra characters），以避免出现不需要的元素。

指定环境互动细节（rain、wet-stone reflections、petals reacting to energy、lantern flicker、fog/fabric responding），以提高真实感和一致性。

明确锁定角色与能力的对应关系（Aisha = orange-gold fire；Harumin = blue-silver wind/frost），并指示“do not swap their powers”，以防止属性漂移。

定义音频要求（intense percussion、footsteps on wet stone、cloth/breathing/whooshes、fire/wind/ice impacts）以及 “no dialogue”，以指导声音生成。
